The '''YT-1210 light freighter''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] that immediately preceded the [[YT-1250 freighter]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Mod_YT-1210.png|thumb|left|YT-1210 diagram]]
Some features of the YT-1210 would be the basis of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. The ship had the familiar saucer-shaped hull of the YT-1300, but lacked the forward cargo loading mandibles that gave that ship its familiar outline. It also included two sensors protruding from the bow, which could be big, tempting targets for anyone attacking the YT-1210.<ref name="POB" />

The YT-1210 was 28 meters in length,<ref name="SaV" /> and the standard crew consisted of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. The stock YT-1210 could carry up to 100 metric tons of cargo, and was armed with a single [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. The ship had a small cabin for the [[Captain/Legends|captain]], and it came equipped with a small refresher station. A YT-1210 could be, and were, modified by their owners.<ref name="POB" />

==History==
YT-1210 was the main production light freighter from Corellian Engineering Corporation, until the YT-1300 arrived. Unfortunately, once sales of the YT-1300 took off at some point before [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the highly capable YT-1210 [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] had a shortened production run.<ref name="POB" /> The YT-1210 was not a poor design, but it was not on par with the speed of YT-1300 and it lacked some of the amenities that the YT-1300 had. Still, the YT-1210, like its more popular successor, could be found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
